Initial release of Caption Generator in Video.

- Add captions and subtitles to MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM videos up to 500MB.

- Fast 30–60 second AI-powered caption generation and 1080p MP4 export.
- Supports quick edits, batch processing, and iterative workflows with session tracking.

- No local installation required — just upload your video and specify caption details.
